messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 15:03 UTC — p99 inference latency spike in us-east-1. streaming stalls up, SLO (p99 < 2.0s) breached. metric: metrics/serving/kv_prefill_decode. possible correlation: kv slab fragmentation / prefill vs decode imbalance. paging eng-sre oncall now. runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/kv-frag 

maria: oncall here, looking. dashboards show prefill eviction rate +82%, decode queue length spiking. affected routes: /chat/stream, /generate. starting triage. @samir can you check recent deploys?

ashok: i'm pulling slab stats and redispatch counters. seeing lots of small keys concentrated on a handful of slabs — hotspotting. think prefill is racing decode and causing eviction churn.

samir: no prod deploys in last 60m. most recent change was scoring tweak yesterday. suggest a quick mitigation: temporarily disable prefill for noisy streaming routes to reduce eviction churn.

maria: agree. can we try a canary toggle (10%) first?

samir: executing canary toggle now. command:
```
redwoodctl config set --region us-east-1 --route-pattern "/chat/stream*" prefill_enabled=false --canary 10
```
output: canary applied to 5 hosts.

maria: canary metrics -> p99 for canary hosts: 4.1s -> 2.2s within 90s. non-canary still high. good signal.

incident-bot: UPDATE: canary shows improvement. requesting rollback window? none needed. recommended: roll to 100% if no regressions.

samir: rolling to 100% now:
```
redwoodctl config set --region us-east-1 --route-pattern "/chat/stream*" prefill_enabled=false --canary 100
```
rollout succeeded.

maria: immediate improvement observed: p95 stable, p99 trending down. still seeing occasional ~5s tails on streaming. checking decode workers.

ashok: scaled decode pool +25% for us-east-1 to handle extra decode load after prefill disable:
```
autoscale set decode-workers --region us-east-1 --delta +25
```
CPU/GPU utilization within limits.

elaine: started trace capture for affected requests and pulled sample eviction logs. attached sample trace ids: 0001a2b3, 0001a2b4. slab stats show fragmentation score high for slab ids 17,18,19.

maria: quick customer impact summary: approx 2% of streaming sessions had stalls >=5s during spike, error rate up ~0.1%. enterprise customer Alpha reported degraded UX in us-east-1 — CS already pinged.

samir: opening tracking ticket RED-INC-7291 with mitigation steps, traces, and dashboard links. owners: eng-sre, storage-team.

incident-bot: NOTE: temporary mitigations in place — prefill disabled on noisy routes, decode pool scaled, reroute policy adjusted to prefer dedicated capacity for high-QPS customers. continue monitoring.

maria: proposed followups (post-incident):
- schedule slab defrag during low-traffic window (suggest 03:00 UTC).
- tune prefill heuristic to prefer decode for streaming patterns and add a per-route override.
- add eviction-monitoring alert that triggers before p99 crosses threshold.
- TTL for tiny KV entries to reduce slab churn.

ashok: i'll take next 2hr watch and coordinate defrag schedule with storage-team. target defrag: 03:00 UTC. handoff notes: p99 went from 4.4s -> 1.9s after mitigations, still above goal for a small tail population.

maria: thanks — handing over to @ashok in 30m. reactions: :thumbsup: 

ashok: taking over. monitoring live charts, will update if anything regresses.

maria: also, quick snippet of a noisy key pattern we saw (sanitized):
```
key: user:chat:session:embedding:smallhash
size: 128 bytes
access pattern: RBURST (hot for 30min then cool)
```
this explains slab hot spots.

elaine: saving logs and traces to RED-INC-7291. will prepare a short technical summary for postmortem.

samir: adding prefill-heuristic PR to backlog, will include benchmark vs decode-only for streaming.

incident-bot: RESOLVED -> mitigations active. continue monitoring. closure will wait for postmortem.

maria: final — if nothing regresses by EOD we'll close the page and move followups to the incident ticket. good work team. :heart:
